20261122-math-g07-2.title: Ma’aunin lissafin layi
20261122-math-g07-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Ma’aunin lissafin layi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-math-g07-2.material: [M1 Binciken Lissafi (Babba)] Matsalar bincike mai zurfi ta amfani da Ma’aunin lissafin layi. Jimillar lambobin halitta guda uku masu jere ita ce $3S$, kuma ribar mafi kankanta da mafi girma idan aka hada da $1$ daidai take da $T^2$. Idan $S = 15$, wacce ce mafi girma cikin ukun?
20261122-math-g07-2.s.s1.prompt: [M1 Binciken Lissafi (Babba)] Matsalar bincike mai zurfi ta amfani da Ma’aunin lissafin layi. Jimillar lambobin halitta guda uku masu jere ita ce $3S$, kuma ribar mafi kankanta da mafi girma idan aka hada da $1$ daidai take da $T^2$. Idan $S = 15$, wacce ce mafi girma cikin ukun?
20261122-math-g07-2.s.s1.explain:
Mataki 1: Idan aka dauki lambobin a matsayin $n-1, n, n+1$, jimillar ita ce $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Mataki 2: Lambobin guda uku su ne $14, 15, 16$.
Mataki 3: Mafi girman lambar ita ce $16$.
Mataki 4: Tabbatarwa: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.

Mataki 3: Mafi kankantar lambar halitta ita ce $B = 1$.

20261125-math-g07-1.s.s1.hint.0: Mafi kankantar darajar lambar halitta ga $B$ ita ce $1$.

20261122-math-g08-2.material: [M2 Binciken Lissafi (Babba)] Matsalar bincike mai zurfi ta amfani da Lissafin aji na 2 na sakandare. Jimillar lambobin halitta guda uku masu jere ita ce $3S$, kuma ribar mafi kankanta da mafi girma idan aka hada da $1$ daidai take da $T^2$. Idan $S = 15$, wacce ce mafi girma cikin ukun?
20261122-math-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: [M2 Binciken Lissafi (Babba)] Matsalar bincike mai zurfi ta amfani da Lissafin aji na 2 na sakandare. Jimillar lambobin halitta guda uku masu jere ita ce $3S$, kuma ribar mafi kankanta da mafi girma idan aka hada da $1$ daidai take da $T^2$. Idan $S = 15$, wacce ce mafi girma cikin ukun?
20261122-math-g08-2.s.s1.explain:
Mataki 1: Idan aka dauki lambobin a matsayin $n-1, n, n+1$, jimillar ita ce $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Mataki 2: Lambobin guda uku su ne $14, 15, 16$.
Mataki 3: Mafi girman lambar ita ce $16$.
Mataki 4: Tabbatarwa: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.

20261125-math-g08-1.s.s1.prompt: [M2 Binciken Lissafi] Tambayar bincike game da Lissafin aji na 2 na sakandare. Lambobin halitta guda biyu $A$ da $B$ suna cika $A + 2B = 24$. Lokacin da $A$ ya dauki mafi girman daraja, menene darajar $B$?
20261125-math-g08-1.s.s1.explain:
Mataki 1: Sake tsara lissafin yana bada $A = 24 - 2B$.
Mataki 2: Tun da $A, B \ge 1$ lambobin halitta ne, $2B$ dole ne ya zama mafi kankanta don $A$ ya zama mafi girma.
Mataki 3: Mafi kankantar lambar halitta ita ce $B = 1$.
Mataki 4: A wannan matsayi, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (mafi girma), don haka $B = 1$.
